pages.text: In order to enter a technique tab enter the Introspection Screen ($(k:wuxiacraft.key.introspection)) select one of the three technique scroll icons with the corresponding color for the cultivation type you want. $(br2)The list on the left is the aspect list where you will pull your aspects from. you can use the search bar above to filer the aspects on the list.

$(br)Start by placing down the start aspect, then place down a generator aspect, then connect a converter aspect to the generator aspect, then connect the system gathering aspect to the converter aspect, then finally compile and save your custom technique. $(br2)A technique is only valid if you see the cultivation speed value at the top right corner of the menu.
Examples of Valid Techniques. $(br)Your grid will grow larger as you reach higher stages.
